limitations: Serialized prefab read only; Unity Editor active state, mesh triangle bounds, collider hits, NavMesh and gameplay were not executed.
Nested prefab and FBX model child meshes may not be expanded in raw YAML; renderer/collider counts are serialized-component counts, not final live Unity counts.
Historical D09 survey supplies original dimensions/opening widths; each current owner frame and active state is read from this prefab.
Loot worldCandidate uses authored local X/Z and historical floorY; actual runtime placement and approach can differ after geometry validation.
